profile.summary: The Food and Nutrition Service is an agency of the United States Department of Agriculture. It runs the nation's domestic nutrition assistance programs, including the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP), school meal programs and WIC. It also administers the Farm to School Grant Program, which funds school gardens, local food purchasing and food education.
